tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: The desktop ground behind windows and the page background. Only ink and ink-muted text sit directly on it.

tokens.name: desk-dot
tokens.usage: The 1px dot grid on the desk, at an 18px pitch. Decorative only.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Window and card surface, inputs, the dock and menus.

tokens.name: window-bar
tokens.usage: Inactive title bars and the menu bar.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Wells: kbd keys, service codes, dock items, the switch track when off, empty heat cells.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Window, card and dock outlines and the lines inside windows. Quiet in Pulse; the bold ink outline in Sage.

tokens.name: edge-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control: inputs, the secondary button, the switch. At least 3:1 on window and desk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on desk, window, window-bar and well.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and title-bar text on desk, window, window-bar, well and signal-soft.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The accent as a fill: the primary button, the active title bar, live dots, notes, the active dock item. Never as text.

tokens.name: lime-edge
tokens.usage: Outline for lime fills: disappears into the fill in Pulse, a bold ink outline in Sage.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lime fill.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The accent as text or a mark inside windows: links, section indexes, the sparkline, selected icons. Darkens to olive in Sage to stay legible. Not on the Sage desk (3.5:1).

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind signal text: connected and syncing badges, the selected command-palette row.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed syncs, invalid fields, expired tokens. Always with the alert glyph and a sentence. As text on window and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text: error badges, inline error notes, the bar of a window that needs attention.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Contribution graph: a day with no activity.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Contribution graph: lowest quarter of the busiest day.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Contribution graph: second quarter.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Contribution graph: third quarter.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Contribution graph: the busiest days. Brightest in Pulse, darkest in Sage.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links inside windows, underlined. An alias of signal.

families.mono: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one hero line per page, inside the about window. Two lines at most.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Things I built and still maintain
styles.usage: Section titles (SectionHeader) and the hero in small windows.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Window headings, project and card titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I build server-side systems that keep working after launch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The sync runs hourly and on every push webhook.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Measure 64ch at most.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, badges. Medium buttons use it at 14px.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code, timestamps, repo names, log lines. Martian Mono runs wide: keep it at 12px or smaller in running UI.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Window titles, the menu bar, dock codes, kbd keys.

styles.name: mono-caps
styles.usage: Ledger keys and section indexes, uppercased by CSS.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stats and the Now clock. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges; between window controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; dock padding and gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Title-bar padding; small button padding; row gaps inside windows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Window body padding; button padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between windows in a grid; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space under a SectionHeader.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sub-sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between top-level sections below the desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above the footer.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Heat cells, kbd keys, window controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, service codes, dock items, command rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Windows, cards, the dock, the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, the switch, status dots.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows only: no blur, no glow.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Windows, cards and the dock at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A hovered or dragged window, and the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Hovered buttons, notes, small floating marks.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap, then a solid 2px ring, lime in Pulse (14:1 on window) and ink in Sage (18:1).

layout.note: The desktop hero, then a 12-column page below it.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Widest content box.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of running text.

tokens.name: columns
tokens.usage: Grid columns on desktop; one column under 720px, where the desk becomes a stack.

tokens.name: desk-pitch
tokens.usage: Spacing of the desk's dot grid.
